mapper.sql: i.id, v.id AS vehicle_id, v.vin, v.lifecycle_stage, COALESCE(i.stage_status, v.lifecycle_stage) AS stage_status, p.model_id, m.model_name, m.series, m.spec, m.model_code, p.year_make, p.exterior_color_id, ec.color_name AS exterior_color_name, p.interior_color_id, ic.color_name AS interior_color_name, i.saic_buy_off_date, i.date_to_storage_yard, i.remark2, i.confirmed_by, i.confirmed_at

FROM t_vehicle v LEFT JOIN t_veh_inbound i ON i.vehicle_id = v.id AND i.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_veh_production p ON p.vehicle_id = v.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_md_model m ON m.id = p.model_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_md_exterior_color ec ON ec.id = p.exterior_color_id AND ec.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_md_interior_color ic ON ic.id = p.interior_color_id AND ic.deleted = 0
